# Lavender Pin Co

> Lavender Pin Co is a one-person Pinterest marketing and Shopify web design service for small businesses and product brands. One specialist handles both Pinterest strategy and website design, so they're built to work together instead of being outsourced separately.

Personalized Shopify web design and Pinterest marketing built around search, not templates. No consultation or application required to purchase any service — checkout, then complete a short post-purchase intake form.

## Services

- [Pinterest Marketing Services](https://lavenderpinco.com/pinterest-marketing.html): overview of all three Pinterest offers
  - [Pinterest SEO Audit](https://lavenderpinco.com/pinterest-audit.html): $197 one-time, full account audit plus a ranked 30-day action plan
  - [Pinterest Business Account Setup & SEO Optimization](https://lavenderpinco.com/pinterest-account-setup.html): $497 one-time, builds or rebuilds the account foundation
  - [Monthly Pinterest Management](https://lavenderpinco.com/pinterest-management.html): done-for-you ongoing management, three tiers from $497 to $1,097/month, no minimum commitment
- [Shopify Web Design Services](https://lavenderpinco.com/web-design.html): overview of both web design offers
  - [Website Starter](https://lavenderpinco.com/website-starter.html): $249 one-time, professional one-page site live in about 5 business days
  - [Complete Shopify Website & Brand Identity Package](https://lavenderpinco.com/complete-package.html): $1,497 one-time, full branding plus a multi-page Shopify store
